blocks.text: We implement all models using the PyTorch framework Paszke et al. (2019) and conduct experiments on an NVIDIA A800 GPU. During unlearning, we only tune the multimodal mapping layers of each MLLM to maintain architectural integrity. All models are trained for a fixed 1 epoch using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate η \eta of 1e-5 and weight decay of 0.05. For our SARE framework, the unlearning loss weight λ 1 \lambda_{1} and sentence loss weight λ 2 \lambda_{2} are set to 0.3 and 0.2, respectively, while the perturbation radius ρ \rho is set to 0.05. Regarding the data curation pipeline described in Sec. 3.3 , the thresholds for visual anchors ( T 0 T_{0} ) and hallucinated targets ( T 1 T_{1} ) are established at 32 and 23. Furthermore, to balance the sample distribution between sentence-level and subsentence-level data, the reliability threshold ( T 2 T_{2} ) for the sentence-level dataset D s ​ e ​ n ​ t D_{sent} is set to 27.5.
